title: Mrs. A.F. Bologovsky Alias Totsky, Alleged Agent Of The Third International

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTRY.
File No.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date March 30, 1935.
Subject...Mrs. A. F. Bologovsky alias Totsky, alleged agent of the
Third International.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by

With reference to the attached memo of Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch) dated February 1, 1935, on the subject of
a Russian girl named Totsky, dancing partner employed in the
Del Monte Cafe, who is alleged to be an agent of the Third
International, discreet enquiries show that her real name
is Mrs. A. F. Bologovsky.
This individual's particulars and antecedents, as known
to this office, are as follows:-
Antonina Fedorovna Bologovsky nee Gnevkovsky was born
on 13.7.1907 at Tiflis, Russia. It is reported that she
arrived in Manchuria from Russia in 1923 together with her
parents. She resided at Handaohedzi Station of the Chinese
Eastern Railway until 1926, when she went to Harbin. Some
time later she married a Russian named Bologovsky. In May
1932 Mrs. Bologovsky arrived in Shanghai from Harbin together
with her daughter aged three years and has since been residing
in this city. Her husband, from whom, for reasons unknown,
she has been living separately for the past several years,
is believed to be in Harbin at present.
Upon her arrival here she resided at No. 734 Avenue
Joffre for several months, after which she removed to House
No. 2-A, Route de Grouchy, where she is still living together
with her elder sister, Mrs. O.F. Pavlovsky, 31, and their
mother, Mrs. C.P. Gnevkovsky, 57, widow, who have been
resident in Shanghai since 1930 and 1932 respectively.
Mrs. Bologovsky has been employed as a dancing partner
at the Del Monte Cafe for over two years. She is generally
known there under the name "Tonia" and appears to be fairly
successful in her professional capacity. Information in

日期：1935年3月30日。
事由……A. F. 博洛戈夫斯基夫人（Bologovsky），又名托茨基（Totsky），据称系第三国际代理人。
呈报人：副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev） 转呈人

关于1935年2月1日副总监（特别科）就一名名为托茨基的俄国女子所涉事宜之备忘录，该女子受雇于德尔蒙特咖啡馆（Del Monte Cafe）担任舞伴，据称系第三国际代理人。经 discreet enquiries（审慎调查）显示，其真名为 A. F. 博洛戈夫斯基夫人。
本处所知该人之个人资料及背景如下：
安东尼娜·费奥多罗芙娜·博洛戈夫斯基（Antonina Fedorovna Bologovsky），婚前姓格涅夫科夫斯基（Gnevkovsky），1907年7月13日出生于俄国第比利斯（Tiflis）。据报，她于1923年随父母从俄国抵达满洲。她居住在中东铁路汉道河子站（Handaohedzi Station），直至1926年前往哈尔滨。不久后，她与一名名为博洛戈夫斯基的俄国人结婚。1932年5月，博洛戈夫斯基夫人携其三岁女儿从哈尔滨抵达上海，并自此居住于本市。其丈夫因不明原因，过去数年一直与她分居，据悉目前身在哈尔滨。
抵沪后，她曾在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）734号居住数月，随后迁至格鲁希路（Route de Grouchy）2-A号房屋，目前仍与其姐姐 O.F. 帕夫洛夫斯基夫人（Mrs. O.F. Pavlovsky，31岁）及母亲 C.P. 格涅夫科夫斯基夫人（Mrs. C.P. Gnevkovsky，57岁，寡妇）同住，其母与姐姐分别自1930年和1932年起居住于上海。
博洛戈夫斯基夫人在德尔蒙特咖啡馆担任舞伴已逾两年。她在该处通常以“托尼亚”（Tonia）之名为人所知，且在职业表现上似乎颇为成功。现有情报亦显

hand also indicates that she is a person of loose morals
and that she has been "kept" at various times by different
men. During the summer of 1934, it is reported, she
visited Japan in company with one of her male friends.
They resided in a small place in the district of Tsiba,
not far from Tokio, which is seldom visited by foreigners.
It is also reported that among the patrons of the Del
Monte Cafe there are several individuals, who seem to
prefer to be in the company of Mrs. Bologovsky, when
visiting that establishment, and that one of them, an
employee of the local branch of the National City Bank
of New York, is her present paramour.
Mrs. Pavlovsky, her sister, was for some time employed
as a waitress at the Cafe Renaissance, Avenue Joffre, after
which she has been working as a dancing partner at the
Del Monte Cafe. She is of the same type as her sister,
as far as her mode of living is concerned. Until recently,
it is believed, she was "kept" by an employee of the Standard
Vacuum Oil Co.
Enquiries do not elicit any information which could
corroborate the allegation regarding Mrs. Bologovsky being
an agent of the Third International. Several persons,
who have known her and her family for a considerable time
while in Shanghai, state that there is nothing whatever in
their private life which could suggest that they take an
interest in politics or are engaged in any activities
connected with politics. They are of humble origin and
limited education and their interests are not above those
of a typical cabaret girl. Most of the males who visit

示她品行不端，且曾不时被不同男子“包养”。据报，1934年夏季，她曾与一名男性友人同游日本。他们居住在东京附近芝区（Tsiba）的一个小地方，该地鲜有外国人涉足。另据报，在德尔蒙特咖啡馆的顾客中，有数人在光顾该场所时似乎更愿与博洛戈夫斯基夫人为伴，其中一人系纽约国家城市银行（National City Bank of New York）本地分行之职员，现为她的姘夫。
其姐帕夫洛夫斯基夫人曾在霞飞路文艺复兴咖啡馆（Cafe Renaissance）担任女侍者一段时间，此后一直在德尔蒙特咖啡馆担任舞伴。就生活方式而言，她与其姐属同一类人。据信，直到最近，她还被美孚真空油公司（Standard Vacuum Oil Co.）的一名职员“包养”。
调查并未获取任何可佐证有关博洛戈夫斯基夫人系第三国际代理人之指控的信息。几位在上海认识她及其家人较长时间的人士表示，在其私生活中没有任何迹象表明她们对政治感兴趣或从事任何与政治相关的活动。她们出身卑微，受教育程度有限，其兴趣并不超出典型歌舞厅女子的范畴。大多数前往

Both Mrs. Bologovsky and all members of her family
are registered with either the Russian Emigrants Committee

at Shanghai (SORO).
